findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "mint_free_key" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hot_products, convert_link · Private data: mint_free_key, search_products, hot_products, product_detail, convert_link, affiliate_orders, categories, catalog_overview, flight_search, shelf_search, shelf_item · Public sink: mint_free_key · Destructive: convert_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hot_products, convert_link · Private data: mint_free_key, search_products, hot_products, product_detail, convert_link, affiliate_orders, categories, catalog_overview, flight_search, shelf_search, shelf_item · Public sink: mint_free_key · Destructive: convert_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
